cases.name: Gena Marie Wade
cases.about:
Her obituary said, "Gena lived a life that was characterized by unwavering devotion to her family, a passion for culinary arts, and an adventurous spirit.

Gena's journey on this Earth was marked by her unyielding love for her family. She was a mother to her beloved daughter, Masie M Wade, and their bond was one filled with tenderness and affection. Gena possessed an unparalleled selflessness that radiated through every aspect of her being. Her nurturing nature created a strong foundation of love within her family, where she played an irreplaceable role as the heart and soul.

Beyond her familial ties, Gena had an exceptional ability to make friends feel like they were part of her extended family. Her warm and inviting nature drew people in effortlessly, making them feel accepted and loved without any reservations. She cherished the time spent with friends and family, whether it was during shared holidays or simple moments of togetherness. Gena's vibrant presence enlivened every gathering she attended.

Gena had a distinct passion for cooking and delighted in preparing meals for those she held dear. The tantalizing aroma that wafted from her kitchen would beckon loved ones from far and wide, drawing them closer with the promise of mouthwatering delights. No holiday or special occasion was complete without Gena's culinary marvels adorning the table.

When not conjuring magic in the kitchen, Gena sought solace in the great outdoors. Fishing expeditions allowed her to connect with nature's tranquility while camping adventures ignited the sparks of her free spirit. The melodic strains of music spoke to her soul and provided a soundtrack to her life. Whether she was humming along to her favorite tunes or attending live concerts, music served as a source of solace and inspiration.

Gena's loyal and cherished companion was her dog, Candy. Together, they formed an unbreakable bond that transcended words. Gena showered her furry friend with unconditional love, finding solace in the presence of a faithful companion who shared in life's joys and sorrows."

Her Go Fund Me said, "There was never a day where she wasn’t helping someone. Gena was the best mother out there and anyone you ask would say, all she talked about was her daughter. Everyone also knew that she spent every moment of every day with her candy girl, she loved her dog like no tomorrow. She loved the outdoors, camping, swimming, fishing and BBQ's in the back yard with friends and family. She fiercely loved her family.

With that being said Gena will always be remembered as the most beautiful, loving, most amazing mother, daughter, sister, cousin, and aunt there ever was. Not a day will go by that Gena won’t be in our hearts. For those of us that she had to leave behind we are just devastated and speechless that she is no longer with us. This world is now a little dimmer without her in it."
